description: Configure Control Plane log collection via Cloud Log Analytics (CLA) for an NKS cluster: audit (Kubernetes audit log) and/or authn (authentication log). Give at least one; an omitted field keeps its current setting. authn=true requires authType=API and Kubernetes 1.26+. Since 2026-09-17 enabling audit is rejected with 400 unless the account has an active CLA subscription — subscribe to Cloud Log Analytics first.

audit.description: Kubernetes audit log (true/false). Omit to keep the current setting

authn.description: Control Plane authentication log (true/false). true is only allowed when authType=API and Kubernetes version is 1.26 or later. Omit to keep the current setting

name: ncloud_nks_set_audit_log
